item.title: Former Comeback Kid bassist Matt Keil diagnosed with ALS, family launches GoFundMe
item.description: Matt Keil, who played bass and shared vocal duties in Comeback Kid between 2008 and 2014, has been diagnosed with ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis). His family confirmed the diagnosis came in May 2024.
